title: Save Bengal Now...
description:
India is facing a growing wave of illegal immigration, especially from Bangladesh and the government seems powerless to stop it. From border infiltration to fake IDs and voter cards, thousands cross into India every year, blending into local populations across Assam, Bengal, and even major cities.

What started as a border issue has now become a national crisis—impacting jobs, security, and social balance. Despite tall promises, policies remain inconsistent and enforcement weak.

In this video, we break down how illegal immigration is reshaping India’s demographics and why silence on this issue could cost the country dearly.
